title: docs(spec): a promoted bulk lookup param carries its field's picker settings, and the spec now says so
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLWnL4JRuSrtWuf1RiKCCsJ)_
Fixes #27050

Ruling-ref: none (triage 6460237597)
Claim: 6468678025
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改文字：`bulk-action.zod.ts` 中 `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` 上方的 JSDoc 与拒收处方、`liveness/view.json` 的 `list.bulkActionDefs` 行、v18 迁移条目 `ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused` 的升级说明，改为：批量操作的字段型查找参数会把字段的 `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` 带到选择栏的选择器，与单条记录对话框一致；`idField` / `titleFormat` 仍不带。
- **为什么改：** #27049 已让批量路径转发这四项，规格文字仍说「被丢弃」，会让作者去绕一个已不存在的问题。
- **风险与回滚：** 不改任何 schema，接受集合不变；只改发布包里的说明文字。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`（拒收处方字符串那一段）。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -n -E "dropped (by|on) the bulk|drops the lookup settings" -- packages ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 预期零命中。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Prose only. The accept set of `BulkActionParamSchema` does not change, and no key is added to or removed from `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS`.

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, JSDoc above `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS`.** The promoted route now carries the field's lookup settings `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` to the selection bar's picker, as the single-record dialog does. "From THIS list only `accept` and `maxSize` make the trip" becomes "only those four and `accept` / `maxSize`", "all but two of these keys" becomes "all but six", and "declare it on the field and let the dialog inherit" is right for those six. The `idField` sentence stays: `idField` has no `FieldSchema` spelling, and the resolver's snake `id_field` read is still not carried onto the bulk param.
- **Same file, the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` refusal prescription.** It now lists the four picker settings among what the promoted route carries, says only `accept` / `maxSize` and those four arrive that way, and its remedy says "for one of those six move the param onto a promoted action".
- **`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, row `list.bulkActionDefs`.** "…and drops the lookup settings." becomes "…and that field's lookup settings `lookupFilters`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `descriptionField`, which reach the selection bar's picker as they reach the single-record dialog's (objectstack#26951); `idField` / `titleFormat` are still not carried."
- **Another copy the merge made false: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts`.** Its `replacement` and `reason` said only `accept` / `maxSize` reach the dialog and the four picker settings are "resolved and then dropped on the bulk path". Both now name the six keys. This is the upgrade guidance `os migrate meta` prints, so it ships in the package.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.test.ts`.** One comment said "only `accept` / `maxSize` make that trip"; it now names the four picker settings too. The assertions are unchanged and still hold: the prescription still contains the text `accept` / `maxSize`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` patch (the prescription and the migration entry text ship in the package).

Not touched: the `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` / `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` lines that quote the old text (release history). `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` and `ui/**` hold no copy of the claim (grep below), so this PR is not governed. Nothing generated reads these strings: the grep finds no generated copy of the prescription, the JSDoc or the liveness note, so there is nothing to regenerate.

## Measure first

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts` `toBulkParam` on `origin/main` `d745bb5e` (PR #27049 merged as `c4ad55ca`, an ancestor: `git merge-base --is-ancestor c4ad55ca HEAD` → exit 0):

```ts
    ...(resolved.descriptionField !== undefined && { descriptionField: resolved.descriptionField }),
    ...(resolved.lookupColumns !== undefined && { lookupColumns: resolved.lookupColumns }),
    ...(resolved.lookupFilters !== undefined && { lookupFilters: resolved.lookupFilters }),
    ...(resolved.lookupPageSize !== undefined && { lookupPageSize: resolved.lookupPageSize }),
```

and its JSDoc: "`idField` / `titleFormat` are still not carried: the resolver reads them off undeclared snake keys only, and no bulk reader has asked for them." `toBulkParam` has no `idField` or `titleFormat` line. The resolver (`ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`) fills them from `field.id_field` and `field.title_format`, and the other four from `field.descriptionField`, `field.lookupColumns`, `field.lookupFilters` and `field.lookupPageSize`, which `FieldSchema` declares (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` L1823–1835).

Copy sweep: `git grep -n -E "dropped (by|on) the bulk|resolved and then dropped|drops the lookup settings|dropped with the lookup settings|make the trip|only .?accept.? (and|/) .?maxSize"` over `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**` and `content/docs/**`, CHANGELOGs excluded. On base it found the three sentences on the card, the migration entry (two places) and the test comment. On head, every hit of the last two patterns names the six keys, and the first four patterns have zero hits (`git grep` exit 1).

## Verification

Base `origin/main` `d745bb5e`; head `0b20e1f14`. Every reading below is from that head.
